stories.headline: DJ Moore scored minus 0.10 and the game finished 143.14 to 143.10
stories.body:
#CrookedAdam beat TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles by four hundredths of a point. It is the only matchup in this league that has finished.

On Friday this desk ran a story headlined "DJ Moore scored minus 0.10 and it may decide a game." Moore was projected for 13.1 and finished on minus 0.10, and it was not a bad night. He went down diving for a pass in the end zone late in the second quarter against Detroit and did not come back. Buffalo called it a shoulder and a stinger; it has since been reported as an AC joint sprain, and he is day to day. The margin was 0.04.

Jack did almost everything right after Thursday. Travis Kelce went for 25.10, Jaylen Waddle for 21.80, Harrison Butker for 16.00, and from Friday morning onwards he outscored Kevin by 17.26. He lost anyway, because a receiver got hurt reaching for a touchdown two days before the rest of his week had started. Tyler Shough scored 24.38 on his bench. Patrick Mahomes scored 34.98 on the other one.

takes.text: Four hundredths. I have been on the wrong end of a game decided by something that small and there is nothing anybody can say to you afterwards. Jack outscored the man by seventeen points over three days and it did not matter, because the scoreboard does not ask when you got them.

I called this variance on Friday and it was not. A projection prices what a player does, not whether he is on the field to do it, and 13.1 points of expected production walked to the locker room in the second quarter. Thirteen points of availability, a game decided by four hundredths. No model in this building was going to catch that.

POINT ZERO FOUR! A hundred and forty-three points! Starts Kelce, starts Waddle, gets sixteen from a KICKER, and loses a football game because a receiver dove for the end zone on Thursday night and did not get up. And there is nobody to be angry at! That is the part I cannot handle! Give me somebody to be angry at!

Mahomes scored 34.98 on the winner's bench. Shough scored 24.38 on the loser's. Between them that is fifty-nine points nobody started in a game decided by four hundredths, and both these men are going to tell you tonight that they played it perfectly.

I said on Friday that minus zero point one was a statement of intent. It was a man getting hurt, and I will take that one back, which is not a sentence I use often. Here is the one I am keeping: this desk reads a Thursday number like it is information. Sometimes it is just a man walking to the locker room. Write it down.

stories.storyline: Does Jack's 143.10 in a loss turn into anything, or is this the week that follows him?

stories.headline: Brian benched Jared Goff for 37.78 and started Dak Prescott for 37.76
stories.body:
Two weeks of this desk telling Brian Millan he is leaving Jared Goff on the bench, and this is how it resolves: Goff scored 37.78 from the bench, Dak Prescott scored 37.76 from the lineup, and the difference is two hundredths of a point.

Goff has now been Team Mountain's best benched player in consecutive weeks. He was worth 20.4 of the 62.0 Brian left unstarted in week one.

Team Mountain lead I'sah Likely to win Deebo 97.56 to 83.42 with Kyren Williams and Davante Adams still to play, worth 29.1 projected. Chris has Isaiah Likely to come and needs 14.14 from him, which would take a career night from a tight end he left on his own bench in week one for 27.8.

takes.text: TWO HUNDREDTHS! I spent an entire story on Friday telling this man he was giving away a football game and he handed me back a quarterback who scored the same number to two decimal places! I am not apologising. I am refusing to apologise. He was still wrong, he was just wrong by nothing.

This is the one that will make him do it again. He made the call, the call came back level, and now he has a season's worth of evidence that it does not matter who he starts. That is how a manager talks himself into the third week of it.

Fifty-eight points on the bench in two weeks and this week it cost him two hundredths of a point. Brian is going to walk around all season saying he was right. He was not right. He was lucky twice, which in this league is the same thing until suddenly it is not.

stories.storyline: Does Brian start Goff in week three now that benching him has cost him nothing?

stories.headline: The desk's called shots, with one football game left to settle them
stories.body:
Five analysts called all six matchups on Friday. One has finished. Here is where it stands if every current leader holds, and five matchups are still live.

Shannon Larp 6-0. Mina Crimes 5-1. Stephen B Smith 4-2. Skip Baseless 4-2. Fat McCafferty 2-4.

Larp is the only one with a clean sheet and he got there by taking every favourite in the building. Baseless went the other way, keeping five of the six Friday leaders on the theory that the team ahead on Friday stays ahead. Baltimore Boofers led by 46.82 on Friday and now trail by 2.04. Crashee'd My Ford led on Friday and now trail by 26.38. Both were his.

And the only matchup that has actually finished was the one Fat McCafferty picked. He took TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles, who lost by 0.04.

takes.text: Point zero four. That is what separates me from three and three. I am not being graded on judgement here, I am being graded on a tenth of a point from a receiver in Buffalo, and every man on this desk knows it.

I said the team that is ahead on Friday spends the weekend being ahead. Two of mine did not and I am aware of how that reads. What I will say is that I called six games with an actual position and Larp called six favourites, and if he wants a trophy for that he can have it.

Five and one, and the one is I'sah Likely to win Deebo, who posted 83.42 against a projection of 124.7. There is nothing to learn from that. Their defense outscored the projection by fourteen and half their lineup did not turn up. Some weeks the model is fine and the football is not.

stories.storyline: Can anybody catch Larp, and does he hold a clean sheet through one more game?

stories.headline: The worst team in the power rankings is beating the fifth-best by 26
stories.body:
Let Baker Bake are twelfth in the power rankings with a rating of 8.2, an all-play record of 0-11, the lowest score in the league in week one at 72.74 and a 2% playoff estimate. On Monday morning they sit on 96.58 and lead Crashee'd My Ford 96.58 to 70.20.

Jomi is fifth in the rankings and started the only perfect lineup in the league in week one. This week his roster was projected for 122.4 and has produced 70.20. Saquon Barkley returned 3.00 against a 16.6 projection, Rhamondre Stevenson 3.60 against 12.3, and Jameson Williams 5.30 against 12.6.

He has Jaxson Dart to come and needs 35.1 if Jeff's Rams defense hits its projection. Jeff got 22.50 from Dalton Kincaid and 17.50 from Omarion Hampton, and left 20.30 on the bench in Jake Ferguson without it mattering.

takes.text: Every season has one of these and it always lands on the man who can least afford it. Jomi did not manage this badly. He started the right nine and four of them had the worst afternoon of their year on the same afternoon.

A hundred and twenty-two projected against seventy scored is a fifty-two point shortfall, which is the largest gap between projection and production on this board. Barkley alone is 13.6 of it. He still has a quarterback to play, so it is not finished, but it is not a lineup problem either and I would not let anybody sell it as one.

The last-placed team in this league is beating the fifth by twenty-six points! Jeff has the worst roster anybody has seen and he is sitting on ninety-six! And I promise you Jomi is going to spend all night watching a rookie quarterback and telling himself there is still a chance.

stories.storyline: Does Let Baker Bake actually win a game, and what does that do to a 2% playoff estimate?

stories.headline: Killian has stopped scoring and leads by 2.04 with Puka Nacua still to play
stories.body:
Team Ketchup finished on 122.76 against a projection of 133.6 and have nobody left. Baltimore Boofers are on 120.72 with Puka Nacua to come, projected for 20.1. Jake needs 2.04 of it.

Killian got 26.00 out of Dalton Schultz, the tight end he picked up off waivers in week one when he dropped Dylan Sampson. He also got 11.10 from Bijan Robinson against a 22.5 projection and 4.40 from David Montgomery against 17.1.

Team Ketchup is Stephen B Smith's championship pick. Baltimore Boofers is Fat McCafferty's. Both men now have their entire season riding on the same receiver, in opposite directions. Jake also left George Kittle and his 18.00 on the bench, which would have settled this before kickoff.

takes.text: Two point zero four. That is what stands between the best playoff number in this league and a loss to a team that was ninth on Friday. I picked Ketchup to win it all and I am going to spend tonight rooting against a receiver like a man with a problem.

Puka Nacua needs two points. Two. He has done that in a quarter with his eyes shut. I picked the Boofers when this desk was laughing and the Boofers are two points from beating the best roster in the league. Write it down.
Kittle scored eighteen on his bench in a game he is losing by two. If Nacua comes up short tonight, Jake does not get to be unlucky. He gets to be a man who benched George Kittle.

stories.storyline: Does one receiver decide both Smith's and McCafferty's championship picks in the same night?
